comparison.objective: Holster an EV plug and hang its cable clear of a parking bay; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Plug insertion plus deformable cable routing and draping versus rigid precision tool use, collar adjustment, locking, and repeated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Plug and cable remain stowed outside the bay versus bounded stopping behavior and verified setting retention.
comparison.reason: Different physical regimes, mechanisms, and outcomes.
